summary:
Submitted a check product that fixes one attributed responsibility on the configuration path and runs a first direct check for it.

Files (draft-relative): submission.json (submitted product), plan_config_durability.json (DirectCheckPlan), harness_config_durability.go (Go test harness run as assurance_generated_test.go in package "."), plus the already-accepted map.json.

Context from the index: submission 1 was accepted, so map v1 is the accepted basis (A1/A2 core overview usable, 16 behaviors, 6 facts, 4 surfaces) and candidate 2324b095… is now paused by this product.

The new obligation: a server must not publish or commit a configuration change as its latest configuration unless the corresponding configuration log entry was durably stored, so the voter set used for quorum, election eligibility and the leader lease always corresponds to an entry in the log/snapshot. It is grounded in appendConfigurationEntry (raft.go 1203-1240, bound symbol appendConfigurationEntry) which calls dispatchLogs and then unconditionally runs setLatestConfiguration(configuration, future.Index()), commitment.setConfiguration and startStopReplication; dispatchLogs assigns the index and pushes the future before StoreLogs and, on a StoreLogs error, answers the future and sets state Follower.

The discriminator: a stable single-voter leader whose next durable log write (the configuration entry) is failed by an injected LogStore wrapper. The harness admits a config_append_attempt (identity attempt=config-append-1) and, after the failure, reports config_state_after_failure with store_failed, append_error, latest_voter_count, latest_index, committed_index and log_last_index. The implication property says that when store_failed is true the node's latest voter count must still equal the pre-attempt voter count; a violation is a node adopting a voter set whose entry is not in its log. Source citations are limited to raft.go 1203-1240/1244-1291, configuration.go 174-195/228-310 and commitment.go 1-104.

Preflight `validate` returned valid=true with no diagnostics. Acceptance, clean-copy execution, the observed result and any resulting Evidence remain with the controller; local compilation was not possible because only the draft directory is writable, so the harness bytes are fixed but unexecuted in this turn.
